author: GamingBolt
description:
Here we are- part 7 of our Resident Evil recap. We’ve spent the last few parts of this series to talk about events in Raccoon City, and now, after having covered the events of Resident Evil 2 and both Outbreak games, here, we’re going to wrap up the Raccoon City storyline (for the time being) with Resident Evil 3. 

Like with our Resident Evil 1 and 2 recaps, do keep in mind that this recap is going to be focusing on Resident Evil 3’s remake, not the original title. With that out of the way, let’s get started.

Resident Evil 3’s story is set across several days, beginning slightly before the events of Resident Evil 2, then running concurrent to it for a good chunk, and then following up on it to reveal Raccoon City’s ultimate fate. Meanwhile, once again, the game also shifts focus to a different protagonist, once again shining the spotlight on STARS member Jill Valentine, who was Resident Evil 1’s co-protagonist with Chris Redfield.
title: Resident Evil 3 FULL STORY EXPLAINED - Part 7 - Before You Play Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
Vampires: Bloodlord Rising is a new vampire-themed open-world survival game that offers its own interesting twists on the genre. Along with the typical gathering, crafting and building you would expect of the genre, it also offers the ability to acquire minions to handle all of the boring stuff for you while you head out into the larger world to take on Inquisitors and other interesting challenges. 

Despite some issues, however, there is a great foundation here, and Mehuman Games has a great opportunity to build on it.
title: Is This The OPEN WORLD VAMPIRE Game We’ve Been Waiting For?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil Requiem is poised to reframe the survival horror blueprint through contrast; fear versus fervour, apprehension versus power, first-person panic versus third-person confidence – all through the eyes of two protagonists. 

What’s more, Requiem introduces some new systems – whilst refining and reintroducing some series staples – that will reward both your restraint and your aggression. This feature outlines the moments, mechanics, and player-driven decisions that are set to make Resident Evil Requiem a standout experience.
title: Resident Evil Requiem - 15 Things We CAN'T WAIT TO DO
